Should we own Northwind Consumer Group (NYCB)? Revenue $5,652M, EBIT margin 14.9%, cash tax 21%, capex 4.5% of revenue, working capital 13.5% of the revenue build. Over 6 years at 11.49% WACC and 2.82% terminal growth: what enterprise value does the FCFF model imply, and how does a +/- 20% change in terminal growth move it?
